Container.Name: dmOffice
Container.Overview:
dmOffice is a self-hosted office suite in the browser that looks and works like Outlook: mail (IMAP/SMTP, many accounts, local copy with attachments, full-text search, rules, learning junk filter), calendar, contacts, tasks, notes (notizi sync) and files.
It ships its own CalDAV, CardDAV and WebDAV server with app passwords, so phones, Thunderbird and the Windows Explorer connect directly - no Nextcloud needed. Multiple users, every user database encrypted with SQLCipher, two-factor sign-in (TOTP), light and dark theme.
Set DMOFFICE_MASTER_KEY to a long random value (e.g. openssl rand -hex 32) and keep it safe: without it the databases cannot be opened. The first visit of the web UI creates the admin account. For access from outside use HTTPS through your reverse proxy.

Config.Name: Web UI
Config.Description: Port for the browser and DAV clients (CalDAV, CardDAV, WebDAV)

Config.Name: Data
Config.Description: Users and encrypted databases (mail, calendar, contacts, files, notes)

Config.Name: DMOFFICE_MASTER_KEY
Config.Description: Master key that wraps the database keys, e.g. 64 characters from 'openssl rand -hex 32'. Empty: dmOffice stores a key file in appdata (weaker). Losing it means losing the data!
